title: Promotion expiry test gaps
text: TC-88 tests one hour before expiry and one hour after. Exact equality was missing. Add three cases at -1, 0 and +1 milliseconds. Checkout total must remain integer minor units.

title: Inventory reservation contention / test_cases
text: TC-204: Seed isolated SKU with stock=1. Send two concurrent POST reservations using different keys. Assert statuses [201,409] and GET stock=0. Replay the winning key and assert same reservation ID.

title: Tenant cache isolation / test_cases
text: TC-311: Create synthetic tenants north and south with userId=42 and different displayNames. Warm north, fetch south, compare full body; reverse order and test cache expiry.
